inputs.about: Filter transactions by payout status.

tools.name: List Payments Payouts
tools.description: List one page of Shopify Payments payouts, newest payout date first. Filter by date, ID boundaries, or transfer status. Continue using returned page_info cursors without filters; pages are never automatically fetched. Requires Shopify Payments and read_shopify_payments_payouts access. Uses the legacy REST Admin API; the connection base URL supplies the API version.

inputs.name: date
inputs.about: Only payouts issued on this ISO 8601 date.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Page size, 1-250; Shopify defaults to 50.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: Return payouts with this transfer status.

inputs.name: last_id
inputs.about: Return payouts before this payout ID.

inputs.name: date_max
inputs.about: Payout date upper bound, inclusive (ISO 8601).

inputs.name: date_min
inputs.about: Payout date lower bound, inclusive (ISO 8601).

inputs.name: since_id
inputs.about: Return payouts after this payout ID.

inputs.name: page_info
inputs.about: Opaque next_page_info or previous_page_info cursor; pass unchanged with only limit, not filters.

tools.name: List Payment Terms Templates
tools.description: Query payment terms templates from Shopify using the GraphQL API. Use when you need to retrieve available payment terms templates, optionally filtered by payment terms type.

inputs.name: payment_terms_type
inputs.about: Payment terms type classification.

tools.name: Receive A List Of All Product Images
tools.description: Retrieves a page of images for a Shopify product, with optional limit, since-ID and field selection.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of product images to return. Accepted values are 1 to 250. Default is 50.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Use to limit the returned data to only the fields you need.

inputs.name: since_id
inputs.about: Return only product images after the specified ID. Use for cursor-based pagination through large result sets.

inputs.name: product_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Shopify product for which to retrieve all images.

tools.name: List Product Listing Product IDs
tools.description: List one page of IDs of products published to your sales-channel app. Uses the legacy REST Admin API and requires merchant-approved read_product_listings access. Follow the returned cursors for more pages; no additional pages are fetched automatically.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum results per page (1-1000). Shopify defaults to 50.

inputs.name: page_info
inputs.about: Opaque next_page_info or previous_page_info cursor. Pass unchanged; only limit can accompany a cursor.

tools.name: List Product Listings
tools.description: List one page of products published to your sales-channel app. Uses the legacy REST Admin API and requires merchant-approved read_product_listings access. Follow next_page_info to continue; no further pages are fetched automatically. Listings inherit read-only product attributes.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Page size (1-1000); Shopify defaults to 50.

inputs.name: handle
inputs.about: Filter by product handle.

inputs.name: page_info
inputs.about: Opaque next_page_info or previous_page_info cursor. Pass unchanged; only limit can accompany a cursor.

inputs.name: product_ids
inputs.about: Comma-separated product IDs to retrieve.

inputs.name: collection_id
inputs.about: Filter by collection ID.

inputs.name: updated_at_min
inputs.about: Only listings updated after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

tools.name: List Product Resource Feedback
tools.description: Retrieve this app's resource feedback for a specific Shopify product. Requires a Sales Channel app with resource-feedback access. Returns feedback states and merchant-facing messages, not feedback from other apps. The REST Admin API is legacy; new public apps must use GraphQL productResourceFeedback.

inputs.name: product_id
inputs.about: ID of the product whose feedback from this app is retrieved.

tools.name: Get product variants
tools.description: Retrieve a page of variants for a specified Shopify product, with optional field selection and pagination using limit and since_id.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of results per page. Default: 50, Maximum: 250.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Use this to retrieve only specific fields you need.

inputs.name: since_id
inputs.about: Restrict results to after the specified variant ID. Used for pagination to retrieve variants created after a specific ID.

inputs.name: product_id
inputs.about: The unique numeric identifier for the product whose variants you want to retrieve.

inputs.name: presentment_currencies
inputs.about: Return presentment prices in only certain currencies, specified by a comma-separated list of ISO 4217 currency codes.

tools.name: Get resource feedback
tools.description: Retrieves the current resource feedback for the shop. Resource feedback is how your app communicates its setup/configuration status to merchants via the Shopify admin. Use this to check what feedback your app has previously submitted (e.g., whether you told merchants that action is required or that setup is successful). Returns empty array if no feedback exists, or a single feedback object representing the most recent status your app reported to Shopify.

tools.name: Retrieve all script tags
tools.description: Retrieves Shopify script tags, with optional filters for URL and date ranges. Supports pagination using a since-ID parameter.

inputs.name: src
inputs.about: Filters results by script URL. Only script tags with this exact URL will be returned.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Controls the quantity of results returned. Default: 50, Max: 250.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of specific fields to include in the response. Use this to restrict the returned script tags to only the specified properties.

inputs.name: since_id
inputs.about: Constrains output to records following a designated ID. Use for pagination to retrieve records after a specific script tag ID.

inputs.name: created_at_max
inputs.about: Shows tags created before this timestamp. Must be in ISO 8601 format.

inputs.name: created_at_min
inputs.about: Shows tags created after this timestamp. Must be in ISO 8601 format.

inputs.name: updated_at_max
inputs.about: Shows tags modified before this timestamp. Must be in ISO 8601 format.

inputs.name: updated_at_min
inputs.about: Shows tags modified after this timestamp. Must be in ISO 8601 format.

tools.name: List Theme Assets (Deprecated)
tools.description: Retrieves metadata for theme assets (files that make up a theme: templates, images, stylesheets, snippets). Returns metadata only—not file content. To get actual file content, you must retrieve assets individually using a separate action. Use the asset_key parameter to retrieve a single asset, or omit it to list all assets in the theme.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of asset fields to include in the response. Available fields: key, public_url, created_at, updated_at, content_type, size, checksum, theme_id. If omitted, all fields are returned.

inputs.name: theme_id
inputs.about: The ID of the theme whose assets you want to retrieve.

inputs.name: asset_key
inputs.about: The path of a specific asset within the theme to retrieve (e.g., 'assets/bg-body.gif', 'layout/theme.liquid'). If provided, only that single asset's metadata is returned instead of all assets.

tools.name: Retrieve order transactions
tools.description: Retrieves all transactions for a specific order. Use when you need to view payment exchanges for an order. Transactions include authorization, sale, capture, void, and refund types.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of field names to show only certain fields in the response (e.g., 'id,kind,status').

inputs.name: order_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the order whose transactions you want to retrieve.

inputs.name: since_id
inputs.about: Retrieve only transactions after the specified transaction ID.

inputs.name: in_shop_currency
inputs.about: Set to true to retrieve transactions in the shop currency. Default is false, which returns presentment currency for multi-currency orders.

tools.name: List usage charges
tools.description: List usage charges for an existing recurring application charge of the app. Optionally project specific fields. Uses Shopify's legacy REST Admin API; this read does not create charges or change billing.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Omit to return all fields.

inputs.name: recurring_application_charge_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of an existing recurring application charge.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: List one page of staff users and their permissions. Available only to private/custom apps on Shopify Plus stores. Shopify Plus Support must approve the read_users scope for the app. A general store OAuth grant is not sufficient. Uses the legacy REST Admin API; the connection base URL supplies the API version. Continue with returned page_info cursors; additional pages are never automatically fetched.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Page size, 1-250; Shopify defaults to 50.

inputs.name: page_info
inputs.about: Opaque pagination cursor from a response Link header; pass unchanged.

tools.name: Mark Comment as Not Spam
tools.description: Marks a comment as not spam in Shopify, restoring it to published or unapproved state. Use this to remove the spam designation from a comment that was incorrectly flagged. The comment status will change from 'spam' to either 'published' (if it was previously approved) or 'unapproved' (if it needs review).

inputs.name: comment_id
inputs.about: Unique numeric identifier for the comment to mark as not spam.

tools.name: Mark Comment as Spam
tools.description: Mark a comment as spam in Shopify. Use when you need to flag a comment as spam and remove it from visibility. When marked as spam, the comment status changes to 'spam', published_at is set to null, and it becomes invisible to blog readers.

inputs.name: comment_id
inputs.about: Unique numeric identifier for the comment to mark as spam.

tools.name: Modify an existing product variant
tools.description: Update an existing product variant in Shopify. Use when you need to modify variant properties like price, SKU, weight, or inventory settings.

inputs.name: sku
inputs.about: A unique identifier for the product variant in the shop (Stock Keeping Unit).

inputs.name: price
inputs.about: The selling price of the variant.

inputs.name: weight
inputs.about: The weight of the product variant in the unit system specified with weight_unit.

inputs.name: barcode
inputs.about: The barcode, UPC, or ISBN number for the product variant.

inputs.name: option1
inputs.about: The value of the first custom product option (e.g., Size, Color).

inputs.name: option2
inputs.about: The value of the second custom product option.

inputs.name: option3
inputs.about: The value of the third custom product option.

inputs.name: taxable
inputs.about: Whether a tax is charged when the product variant is sold.

inputs.name: image_id
inputs.about: The unique numeric identifier for a product's image to associate with this variant.

inputs.name: tax_code
inputs.about: The tax code for the product variant.

inputs.name: variant_id
inputs.about: The unique numeric identifier for the product variant to update.

inputs.name: weight_unit
inputs.about: The unit of measurement for the product variant's weight. Valid values: 'g', 'kg', 'oz', 'lb'.

inputs.name: compare_at_price
inputs.about: The original price of the item before an adjustment or a sale. Set to null to remove compare at price.

inputs.name: inventory_policy
inputs.about: Whether customers are allowed to place an order for the product variant when it's out of stock. Valid values: 'deny' (customers cannot order when out of stock), 'continue' (customers can order when out of stock).

inputs.name: requires_shipping
inputs.about: Whether the product variant requires shipping.

tools.name: Modify existing webhook (Deprecated)
tools.description: Modify an existing webhook subscription's delivery URI, data format, or payload fields; the topic cannot be changed by this tool. Subscriptions are scoped to the app that registered them, and subscriptions created through Shopify admin cannot be accessed through the API.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Array of top-level resource fields to include in webhook POST requests. If omitted, all fields are included in the payload.

inputs.name: format
inputs.about: Data format for transmission - either 'json' or 'xml'. Defaults to 'json' if not specified.

inputs.name: address
inputs.about: The destination URI where webhook POST requests are sent. Supports HTTPS endpoints, Google Pub/Sub (pubsub://projectName:topicName), and Amazon EventBridge ARN formats. This is the primary field for updating webhook delivery location.

inputs.name: webhook_id
inputs.about: The unique numeric identifier for the webhook subscription to modify.

inputs.name: metafield_namespaces
inputs.about: Array of metafield namespaces to include in webhook payloads. Allows filtering which metafields are sent with webhook events.

tools.name: Move Fulfillment Order to New Location
tools.description: Move a fulfillment order from one merchant managed location to another. Use when you need to relocate unfulfilled items to a different location. The operation will fail if the fulfillment order is closed or if the destination location has never stocked the requested inventory item.

inputs.name: new_location_id
inputs.about: The ID of the destination location where the fulfillment order will be moved. The destination location must have previously stocked the requested inventory item.

inputs.name: fulfillment_order_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the fulfillment order to move.

inputs.name: fulfillment_order_line_items
inputs.about: Array of fulfillment order line items to move. Each item must contain an ID and quantity. If omitted, all unfulfilled line items will be transferred to the new location.

tools.name: Open Fulfillment Order
tools.description: Mark a scheduled fulfillment order open before its fulfill_at datetime. Use to make a scheduled order ready for fulfillment early. Requires access to the order's merchant-managed or third-party fulfillment location. Does not create a fulfillment or reopen a completed order. Uses the legacy REST Admin API.

inputs.name: fulfillment_order_id
inputs.about: ID of the scheduled fulfillment order to make ready for fulfillment.

tools.name: Pin metafield definition
tools.description: Pin a metafield definition in Shopify admin. Use when you need to organize metafields by pinning them to control their display order and visibility. Pinned metafields are automatically displayed in the admin interface.

inputs.name: identifier
inputs.about: Alternative method to identify metafield definition by owner type, namespace and key.

inputs.name: definitionId
inputs.about: The ID of the metafield definition to pin. Must be a Shopify GID in the format 'gid://shopify/MetafieldDefinition/{id}' or just the numeric ID. Either definitionId or identifier must be provided.

tools.name: Publish collection listing
tools.description: Publish an existing collection to this app's sales channel. Only sales-channel apps can publish collection listings. Products in the collection are not automatically published; publish them separately. REST Admin API is legacy; new public apps must use GraphQL Admin API.

inputs.name: collection_listing
inputs.about: Collection listing to publish, containing its collection_id.

inputs.name: collection_listing_id
inputs.about: Collection ID used in the collection listing URL.

tools.name: Publish product listing
tools.description: Publish an existing product to the calling app's sales channel. Requires merchant-approved product listing access. Listing attributes are inherited from the product and cannot be modified here. Draft or archived products are not published immediately; activate the product first. Subscription-only products can only be listed on the online store. REST Admin API is legacy; new public apps must use GraphQL Admin API.

inputs.name: product_listing
inputs.about: Product listing to publish, containing its product_id.

inputs.name: product_listing_id
inputs.about: Product ID used in the product listing URL.

tools.name: Query app by API key
tools.description: Query app information by API key using Shopify's GraphQL Admin API. Use when you need to retrieve metadata about a Shopify app using its client ID. Returns null if no app is found with the provided API key.

inputs.name: api_key
inputs.about: The client ID of the app to retrieve. This is the unique API key assigned to the application.

tools.name: Query business entities
tools.description: Retrieve all business entities associated with the shop. Use when you need to view business entities for assigning to markets, managing payment providers per entity, or checking order attribution.

tools.name: Query business entity
tools.description: Query business entity information from Shopify. Use when you need to retrieve business entity details such as company name, address, and payment account information. If no ID is provided, returns the primary business entity.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID of the business entity to retrieve. If omitted, returns the primary business entity.

tools.name: Query catalogs
tools.description: Queries catalogs from Shopify using the GraphQL Admin API. Catalogs control which products are published and how they're priced in different contexts such as international markets, B2B company locations, or specific sales channels.

inputs.name: last
inputs.about: Number of final elements to retrieve. Use for backward pagination.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Type of catalog to filter by.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Cursor for elements following a specified position. Use with 'first' for forward pagination.

inputs.name: first
inputs.about: Number of initial elements to retrieve. Use for forward pagination.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: Custom filter using Shopify API search syntax. Example: 'status:ACTIVE' to filter by status.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Cursor for elements preceding a specified position. Use with 'last' for backward pagination.

inputs.name: reverse
inputs.about: Reverse the order of the results. Defaults to false (ascending order).

inputs.name: sort_key
inputs.about: Sort keys for catalogs.

tools.name: Query channel by ID
tools.description: Query a single Shopify channel by ID. Use when you need to retrieve detailed information about a specific sales channel including its associated app, name, handle, and publishing capabilities.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID of the Channel to return. Must be in the format: gid://shopify/Channel/{numeric_id}

tools.name: Query consent policy regions
tools.description: Query the list of countries and regions for which consent policies can be created in Shopify. Use when you need to retrieve all available consent policy regions for compliance purposes.

tools.name: Query current app installation
tools.description: Query the currently authenticated app installation on a Shopify store. Use when you need to retrieve details about the current app's installation including access scopes, active subscriptions, launch URL, and uninstall URL.

tools.name: Query current Shopify bulk operation
tools.description: Query the status of the most recent Shopify bulk query or mutation operation, including its result download URL when available.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Determines whether to retrieve the most recent query or mutation bulk operation. Default: QUERY

tools.name: Query customer account pages
tools.description: Query pagination information for Shopify customer account pages using the GraphQL Admin API. The response contains page cursors and pagination flags, not page details.

inputs.name: last
inputs.about: Number of final elements to retrieve from the paginated list. Use for backward pagination.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Cursor for elements following a specified position. Use with 'first' for forward pagination.

inputs.name: first
inputs.about: Number of initial elements to retrieve from the paginated list. Use for forward pagination.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Cursor for elements preceding a specified position. Use with 'last' for backward pagination.

inputs.name: reverse
inputs.about: Reverse the order of the underlying list. Defaults to false (ascending order).

tools.name: Query deletion events
tools.description: Query Shopify deletion events for products and collections, with pagination, sorting, and filtering options.

inputs.name: last
inputs.about: The last n elements before the `before` cursor. Use for backward pagination. Maximum value: 250.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Returns elements that come after the specified cursor. Use for forward pagination with the endCursor from pageInfo.

inputs.name: first
inputs.about: The first n elements from the paginated list. Use for forward pagination. Maximum value: 250.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: Query filter using search syntax. Supports filtering by 'id' and 'occurred_at' fields. Example: 'occurred_at:>2024-01-01' or 'id:12345'.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Returns elements that come before the specified cursor. Use for backward pagination with the startCursor from pageInfo.

inputs.name: reverse
inputs.about: Reverse the order of results. Default is false (ascending order).

inputs.name: sort_key
inputs.about: Sort keys for deletion events.

inputs.name: subject_types
inputs.about: Filter deletion events by subject type. Defaults to all supported subject types.

tools.name: Query disputes
tools.description: Query Shopify Payments disputes using the GraphQL Admin API. Use when you need to retrieve information about payment disputes, including their status and initiation date. Supports pagination and filtering by status or ID.

inputs.name: last
inputs.about: Return up to the last n elements from the paginated list. Use for backward pagination.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Returns the elements that come after the specified cursor. Use with 'first' for forward pagination.

inputs.name: first
inputs.about: Return up to the first n elements from the paginated list. Use for forward pagination.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: Search query for filtering results. Supports id and status filters. Example: 'status:WON' or 'id:12345'.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Returns the elements that come before the specified cursor. Use with 'last' for backward pagination.

inputs.name: reverse
inputs.about: Reverse the order of the underlying list. Defaults to false (ascending order).

tools.name: Query domain
tools.description: Query a specific domain by its ID from Shopify. Use when you need to retrieve domain details including host, URL, SSL status, and localization settings.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Globally unique identifier for the domain in the format gid://shopify/Domain/{numeric_id}. Example: gid://shopify/Domain/105313763522

tools.name: Query events
tools.description: Query events from Shopify using the GraphQL Admin API. Events track actions performed on store resources like products, orders, collections, customers, and more. Use this to retrieve activity history, audit changes, monitor recent actions, or build activity feeds. Returns detailed information about each event including the action type, affected resource, timestamp, and description.

inputs.name: last
inputs.about: Number of final elements to retrieve. Use for backward pagination. Maximum: 250.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Cursor for elements following a specified position. Use with 'first' for forward pagination.

inputs.name: first
inputs.about: Number of initial elements to retrieve. Use for forward pagination. Maximum: 250.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: Custom filter using Shopify API search syntax. Supported fields: action, comments, created_at, id, subject_type. Example: 'subject_type:PRODUCT' or 'action:create AND created_at:>2023-01-01'.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Cursor for elements preceding a specified position. Use with 'last' for backward pagination.

inputs.name: reverse
inputs.about: Reverse the order of the results. Defaults to false (ascending order).

inputs.name: sort_key
inputs.about: Sort keys for events.

tools.name: Query events count
tools.description: Query the count of events in Shopify using the GraphQL Admin API. Use when you need to get the total number of events with optional filtering by date, subject type, or other criteria. Returns both the count and precision indicator.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: Optional filter query for events. Use Shopify search syntax to filter events (e.g., 'created_at:>=2024-01-01' to filter by creation date, or 'subject_type:PRODUCT' to filter by resource type). If not provided, returns count of all events.

tools.name: Query job
tools.description: Query a single job by its ID using Shopify's GraphQL API. Use when you need to check the status of an asynchronous job. Jobs track long-running operations like bulk operations, mutations, or imports.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID of the job to query. Must be a Shopify global ID format like gid://shopify/Job/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000

tools.name: Query metafield definition by ID
tools.description: Query metafield definition details by ID using Shopify's GraphQL Admin API. Use when you need to retrieve metadata about a metafield definition including its type, namespace, key, and usage count. Returns null if no metafield definition is found with the provided ID.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Global identifier for the metafield definition. Must be in the format: gid://shopify/MetafieldDefinition/XXX where XXX is the numeric ID.

tools.name: Query metafield definitions
tools.description: Query metafield definitions from Shopify using the GraphQL Admin API. Use this to retrieve the schema and configuration of metafields for a specific resource type (PRODUCT, COLLECTION, CUSTOMER, etc.). Returns detailed information about each metafield definition including name, namespace, key, type, and validation rules.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Cursor for elements following a specified position. Use with 'first' for forward pagination.

inputs.name: first
inputs.about: Number of metafield definitions to retrieve. Use for pagination. Maximum: 250. Defaults to 250.

inputs.name: namespace
inputs.about: Filter metafield definitions by namespace. Only returns definitions within the specified namespace.

inputs.name: ownerType
inputs.about: The resource type to filter metafield definitions by (e.g., PRODUCT, COLLECTION, CUSTOMER, ORDER). This determines which type of resource's metafield definitions will be returned.

inputs.name: pinnedStatus
inputs.about: Filter by pinned status of metafield definitions.

tools.name: Query metafield definition types
tools.description: Queries all available metafield definition types from Shopify using the GraphQL Admin API. Returns comprehensive information about each type including its category, supported validations, and migration capabilities. Use this to discover what metafield types can be created and what validation rules are available for each type.

tools.name: Query node by ID
tools.description: Query any Shopify resource by its global ID using the node query. Use when you have a GID and need to retrieve the basic resource information.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The globally unique identifier (GID) in Relay format for the node to retrieve. Must be in the format gid://shopify/{ResourceType}/{numeric_id}. Examples: gid://shopify/Product/108828309, gid://shopify/Shop/64462848194, gid://shopify/Customer/123456789

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Optional GraphQL inline fragment to query specific fields based on the node type. Example: '... on Shop { name email }' or '... on Product { title handle status }'. If not provided, only the id field will be returned.

tools.name: Query nodes by IDs
tools.description: Query nodes by their IDs from the Shopify GraphQL Admin API. Use when you need to retrieve multiple Shopify objects by their global IDs (GIDs). Returns node objects with at least an id field, or null for non-existent nodes.

inputs.name: ids
inputs.about: An array of ID values representing the IDs of the Nodes to return. IDs must be in Shopify GID format (e.g., gid://shopify/Product/123, gid://shopify/Shop/1, gid://shopify/Customer/456). Maximum of 250 IDs per request.

tools.name: Query online store
tools.description: Query the online store's password protection status using Shopify's GraphQL Admin API.

tools.name: Query product duplicate job
tools.description: Query a product duplicate job by its ID using Shopify's GraphQL API. Use when you need to check the status of a product duplication operation.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID of the product duplicate job to query. Must be a Shopify global ID format like gid://shopify/ProductDuplicateJob/1234567890

tools.name: Query public API versions
tools.description: Query available public API versions from Shopify using the GraphQL Admin API. Returns a list of all API versions with their support status. Use this to check which API versions are currently supported before making version-specific API calls.

tools.name: Query publication by ID
tools.description: Query a Shopify publication by ID for its name, auto-publish settings, future publishing support, and associated catalog. Partial publication data may be returned without GraphQL errors when some fields fail.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Globally unique identifier for the publication in the format gid://shopify/Publication/{numeric_id}. Example: gid://shopify/Publication/1

tools.name: Query server pixel configuration
tools.description: Query Shopify's server pixel configuration to retrieve its ID, status, and webhook endpoint address. Requires read_pixels or read_server_pixels access.

tools.name: Query Shop (GraphQL)
tools.description: Retrieve Shopify shop information through the GraphQL Admin API, including configuration such as name, email, domain, currency settings, and enabled features. Fields can be selected, subject to the response's supported shop fields.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Optional GraphQL field selection string to customize which shop fields to retrieve. If not provided, a default set of commonly used fields will be returned. Example: 'name email myshopifyDomain currencyCode'

tools.name: Query shop billing preferences
tools.description: Query the shop's billing preferences from Shopify using the GraphQL Admin API. Use when you need to retrieve the currency used for billing apps and services.

tools.name: Query Shopify Functions
tools.description: Query Shopify Functions owned by the API client installed on the shop. Use when you need to retrieve functions that customize Shopify's backend logic such as discounts, checkout validation, and fulfillment.

inputs.name: last
inputs.about: Number of final elements to retrieve. Use for backward pagination.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Cursor for elements following a specified position. Use with 'first' for forward pagination.

inputs.name: first
inputs.about: Number of initial elements to retrieve. Use for forward pagination.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Cursor for elements preceding a specified position. Use with 'last' for backward pagination.

inputs.name: apiType
inputs.about: Filter the functions by the API type (e.g., 'product_discount', 'order_discount', 'shipping_discount').

inputs.name: reverse
inputs.about: Reverse the order of the underlying list. Defaults to false (ascending order).

inputs.name: useCreationUi
inputs.about: Filter the functions by whether or not the function uses the creation UI in the Admin.

tools.name: Query Shop Pay payment request receipts
tools.description: Query Shop Pay payment request receipts from Shopify using the GraphQL Admin API. Use when you need to retrieve and list Shop Pay payment request receipts. Note: This query requires API version 2026-01 or later.

inputs.name: last
inputs.about: Number of final elements to return. Use for backward pagination. Cannot be used with 'first'.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Cursor for pagination - returns elements after this cursor. Use with 'first' for forward pagination.

inputs.name: first

tools.description: Sends an account activation invite email to an existing customer, allowing them to set up their online store account. Use this action to: - Send account activation emails to newly created customers who haven't activated their accounts yet - Resend activation invites to customers who didn't receive or lost the original email - Send custom invitation emails with personalized subject lines and messages The customer must not already have an active account. If the customer has already activated their account, this action will fail with a 422 error.

inputs.name: to
inputs.about: The recipient's email address for the account invitation. If not provided, uses the customer's existing email address.

inputs.name: bcc
inputs.about: Email addresses to receive blind carbon copies of the invitation.

inputs.name: from
inputs.about: The sender's email address (typically the shop owner's email). If not provided, uses the default shop email.

inputs.name: subject
inputs.about: Custom subject line for the invitation email. If not provided, uses the default subject line 'Customer account activation'.

inputs.name: customer_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the customer to send the account invite to.

inputs.name: custom_message
inputs.about: Additional personalized text to include in the invitation body. If not provided or empty, uses the default message.

tools.name: Send Customer Account Invite
tools.description: Sends a customer an invitation email to activate a legacy Shopify customer account. The invitation can use the store's default template or a custom subject and message; legacy customer accounts must be enabled.

inputs.name: to
inputs.about: The recipient's email address for the account invitation. If not provided, the invitation will be sent to the customer's existing email address on file. Use this when you want to send the invite to a different email than the one associated with the customer record.

inputs.name: bcc
inputs.about: Email addresses to receive blind carbon copies of the invitation.

inputs.name: from
inputs.about: The sender's email address shown in the 'From' field of the invitation email. If not provided, uses the store's default notification email address. This is typically the shop owner's email.

inputs.name: subject
inputs.about: Custom subject line for the invitation email. If not provided, Shopify uses the default subject line 'You've been invited to activate your account'. Customize this to make the invitation more personal or relevant to your brand.

inputs.name: customer_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the customer to send the account invite to.

inputs.name: custom_message
inputs.about: Additional personalized text to include in the body of the invitation email. This message appears in the email along with the standard invitation text and activation link. Use this to add a personal touch or provide additional context about your store.

tools.name: Send an invoice
tools.description: Send an invoice email for a draft order to a customer. Use when you need to email an invoice to a customer for a specific draft order.

inputs.name: draft_order_id
inputs.about: The numeric identifier of the draft order to send the invoice for.

inputs.name: draft_order_invoice
inputs.about: Draft order invoice details for sending an invoice email.

tools.name: Set Default Customer Address
tools.description: Set a specific address as the default address for a customer. Use when you need to mark an address as default for tax and shipping calculations. The default address cannot be deleted.

inputs.name: address_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the address to set as the default address for the customer. The default address is used for tax and shipping calculations.

inputs.name: customer_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the customer whose address will be set as default.

tools.name: Set Fulfillment Orders Deadline
tools.description: Set the latest fulfillment deadline for multiple fulfillment orders. Use when you need to update deadline for one or more fulfillment orders.

inputs.name: fulfillment_deadline
inputs.about: The new fulfillment deadline in ISO 8601 format with timezone (e.g., '2025-12-30T10:00:00-05:00')

inputs.name: fulfillment_order_ids
inputs.about: Array of fulfillment order IDs for which the deadline applies

tools.name: Set inventory level
tools.description: Set inventory level for an item at a location. Use when you need to establish or update inventory quantity for a specific item at a designated location. If the location isn't already connected, the connection occurs automatically. The inventory item must have inventory tracking enabled before setting inventory levels.

inputs.name: available
inputs.about: The quantity to be set in inventory. This is the available quantity of the inventory item at the location.

inputs.name: location_id
inputs.about: The ID of the location where the inventory level will be set. To find the ID of the location, use the Location resource.

inputs.name: inventory_item_id
inputs.about: The ID of the inventory item to set the level for. The inventory item must have inventory tracking enabled. To find the ID of the inventory item, use the Inventory Item resource.

inputs.name: disconnect_if_necessary
inputs.about: Whether inventory for any previously connected locations will be set to 0 and the locations disconnected. Omit unless Shopify requires this for fulfillment service locations.

tools.name: Set metafields
tools.description: Create or update multiple metafields in a single operation using the metafieldsSet GraphQL mutation. Use when you need to set custom metadata on Shopify resources like shops, products, customers, or orders. Supports up to 25 metafields per request.

inputs.name: metafields
inputs.about: Array of metafield inputs to set. Maximum of 25 metafields per request. Minimum of 1 metafield required.

tools.name: Submit Fulfillment Cancellation Request
tools.description: Request cancellation from the fulfillment service handling a fulfillment order. This sends a request, not an immediate cancellation: the service can accept or reject it. Optionally supply a reason. Uses the legacy REST Admin API.

inputs.name: cancellation_request
inputs.about: Cancellation request containing an optional reason.

inputs.name: fulfillment_order_id
inputs.about: ID of the fulfillment order assigned to a fulfillment service.

tools.name: Submit Fulfillment Request
tools.description: Request fulfillment from the service assigned to a fulfillment order. Select line items and quantities or leave them blank to request all items. Partial requests can split the fulfillment order. This submits a request, not a completed fulfillment; the service may accept or reject it. Uses the legacy REST Admin API.

inputs.name: fulfillment_request
inputs.about: Optional message, customer notification and line item selection.

inputs.name: fulfillment_order_id
inputs.about: Fulfillment order ID assigned to a fulfillment service.

tools.name: Trigger Shopify Flow
tools.description: Trigger Shopify Flow workflows that begin with the specified trigger handle. Use when you need to manually activate Flow automation workflows from your app. The payload must be under 50 KB and match the trigger's expected schema. To learn more, refer to Create Shopify Flow triggers documentation.

inputs.name: handle
inputs.about: The unique handle of the Flow trigger to activate. This identifies which Shopify Flow workflows should be triggered. If not provided, all workflows that use this trigger will be activated.

inputs.name: payload
inputs.about: The JSON payload data needed to run the trigger (must be under 50 KB). This data is passed to the Flow workflows that begin with the specified trigger. The structure should match the trigger's expected input schema.

tools.name: Unpublish collection listing
tools.description: Unpublish a collection from this app's sales channel by deleting its listing. Does not delete the underlying collection. Requires a sales-channel app with merchant-approved product listing access. Uses the legacy REST Admin API; new public apps must use the GraphQL Admin API.

inputs.name: collection_listing_id
inputs.about: ID of the collection listing to unpublish from this app's sales channel.

tools.name: Unpublish product listing
tools.description: Unpublish a product from this app's sales channel by deleting its listing. Does not delete the underlying product. Requires a sales-channel app with merchant-approved product listing access. Uses the legacy REST Admin API; new public apps must use the GraphQL Admin API.

inputs.name: product_listing_id
inputs.about: Product ID of the listing to unpublish from this app's sales channel.

tools.name: Update app subscription line item capped amount
tools.description: Update the capped amount on usage-based billing for an app subscription line item. Use when adjusting usage limits based on merchant needs or changing pricing models. The mutation returns a confirmation URL where the merchant must approve the new pricing limit before it takes effect. Learn more at https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/launch/billing/subscription-billing/update-max-charge.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The global ID of the app subscription line item to update. Must be in the format: gid://shopify/AppSubscriptionLineItem/{id}

inputs.name: cappedAmount
inputs.about: The new maximum amount of usage charges that can be incurred within a subscription billing interval. This cap prevents merchants from exceeding the specified threshold.

tools.name: Update Article
tools.description: Update an existing article in a Shopify blog. Use when you need to modify article properties such as title, content, tags, or publication status.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of tags. Tags are additional short descriptors for the article.

inputs.name: image
inputs.about: Image object for an article

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: The headline of the article.

inputs.name: author
inputs.about: Name credited as the article's creator.

inputs.name: blog_id
inputs.about: The ID of the blog containing the article to update.

inputs.name: body_html
inputs.about: The text of the body of the article, complete with HTML markup.

inputs.name: published
inputs.about: Whether the article is visible.

inputs.name: article_id
inputs.about: The ID of the article to update.

inputs.name: metafields
inputs.about: Custom metadata fields with key, namespace, value, and type.

inputs.name: published_at
inputs.about: Date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the article becomes visible.

inputs.name: summary_html
inputs.about: Brief summary with HTML markup for display on other pages.

tools.name: Modify an existing blog
tools.description: Updates an existing blog's configuration in your Shopify store. Use this to change the blog title, URL handle, comment moderation settings, custom templates, or attach metadata. Common use cases: rebranding blogs, enabling/disabling comments, switching to custom themes, or fixing SEO-friendly handles. Requires the blog_id and at least one field to update. WARNING: Changing the handle affects URLs and SEO - consider redirects when modifying established blogs.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: New title for the blog (max 255 characters). Updates the blog's display name.

inputs.name: handle
inputs.about: URL-friendly unique identifier for the blog (auto-generated from title if not provided). Used in blog URLs like /blogs/{handle}. WARNING: Changing the handle affects SEO and may break existing links - consider implementing redirects.

inputs.name: blog_id
inputs.about: The unique numeric identifier for the blog to modify. Can be obtained from the blog list or creation response.

inputs.name: feedburner
inputs.about: FeedBurner identifier for RSS feed integration. NOTE: FeedBurner has been discontinued by Google and is not recommended for new implementations.

inputs.name: metafields
inputs.about: Array of metafield objects to attach custom metadata to the blog. Each requires: key (max 30 chars), namespace (max 20 chars), value, and type. Useful for storing custom data like sponsorship info, internal tracking codes, or integration data.

inputs.name: commentable
inputs.about: Comment policy for blog articles: 'no' (disables all comments), 'moderate' (requires approval before publishing), or 'yes' (allows immediate public comments).

inputs.name: template_suffix
inputs.about: Name of alternate Liquid template file to use instead of default blog.liquid. For example, 'custom' uses blog.custom.liquid. Set to null to revert to default template.

inputs.name: feedburner_location
inputs.about: Full URL to the FeedBurner RSS feed location. NOTE: FeedBurner has been discontinued by Google.

tools.name: Update carrier service
tools.description: Update a carrier service created by the connected app. Changes its name, callback URL, activation or service discovery settings. Requires write_shipping and a store eligible for carrier-calculated shipping (including an eligible development store). Only the creating app can update the service. Uses Shopify's legacy REST Admin API.

inputs.name: carrier_service
inputs.about: Properties to update. Omit properties that should not change.

inputs.name: carrier_service_id
inputs.about: Numeric ID of the carrier service created by the connected app.

tools.name: Update Comment
tools.description: Update an existing comment on a blog article in Shopify. Use when you need to modify comment properties such as body text, author, or publication date. Note: This endpoint requires 'protected customer data' access because comments contain customer information (author name, email, IP address). Ensure the app has proper permissions before using this action.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: The basic Textile markup of the comment.

inputs.name: email
inputs.about: The email address of the author of the comment. This is protected customer data.

inputs.name: author
inputs.about: The name of the author of the comment. This is protected customer data.

inputs.name: comment_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the comment to update.

inputs.name: published_at
inputs.about: The date and time when the comment was published in ISO 8601 format.

tools.name: Update Country (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Updates an existing country's tax configuration in Shopify. This endpoint is deprecated as of API version 2024-07 and may return 403 Forbidden errors. The tax field has been read-only since API version 2020-10. Shopify recommends migrating to the GraphQL Admin API's Countries in shipping zone API instead. This action should not be used for new implementations.

inputs.name: tax
inputs.about: The national sales tax rate applied to orders from this country, expressed as decimal (e.g., 0.05 for 5%). READ-ONLY since API version 2020-10 - this field cannot be modified via the API. The entire Country PUT endpoint is deprecated as of 2024-07 and may return 403 Forbidden.

inputs.name: country_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the country to update.

tools.name: Update Province Tax Information
tools.description: Update Province Tax Information

inputs.name: tax
inputs.about: Sales tax rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 = 5%). DEPRECATED as of API version 2020-10. Avoid using this field.

inputs.name: tax_name
inputs.about: The display name for the tax applied to the province. Common values: 'GST', 'HST', 'PST', 'VAT', 'QST'.

inputs.name: tax_type
inputs.about: The type of provincial tax calculation. 'normal': standard tax, 'harmonized': combines federal and provincial taxes, 'compounded': tax on tax.

inputs.name: country_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the country containing the province. Get this from the countries list endpoint.

inputs.name: province_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the province to update. Get this from the provinces list for a country.

tools.name: Update Country
tools.description: Update an existing country's tax configuration in Shopify. Use when you need to modify tax settings for a country. Note: This action is DEPRECATED as of 2024-07, and custom tax values cannot be created or updated as of 2020-10.

inputs.name: tax
inputs.about: The national sales tax rate applied to orders as a decimal value (e.g., 0.1 for 10%). DEPRECATED: As of 2020-10, custom tax values can no longer be created or updated.

inputs.name: country_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the country to update.

tools.name: Update custom collection
tools.description: Update an existing custom collection in Shopify. Use when you need to modify properties of a custom collection such as title, description, publication status, or sorting order.

inputs.name: image
inputs.about: Image to attach to the custom collection.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: The title of the custom collection. Maximum length: 255 characters.

inputs.name: handle
inputs.about: A human-friendly unique string for the custom collection automatically generated from its title. Maximum length: 255 characters.

inputs.name: body_html
inputs.about: The description of the custom collection, including HTML markup.

inputs.name: published
inputs.about: Whether the custom collection is published to the Online Store channel.

inputs.name: sort_order
inputs.about: The order in which products in the custom collection appear. Valid values: 'alpha-asc', 'alpha-desc', 'best-selling', 'created', 'created-desc', 'manual', 'price-asc', 'price-desc'.

inputs.name: published_at
inputs.about: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the collection was published.

inputs.name: published_scope
inputs.about: Whether the collection is published to the Point of Sale channel. Valid values: 'web' (Online Store only) or 'global' (both Online Store and Point of Sale).

inputs.name: template_suffix
inputs.about: The suffix of the Liquid template being used (e.g., 'custom' for collection.custom.liquid).

inputs.name: custom_collection_id
inputs.about: The ID of the custom collection to update. This is a required path parameter.

tools.name: Update Customer
tools.description: Update an existing customer in Shopify. Use when you need to modify customer details such as name, email, phone, tags, addresses, or marketing consent preferences.

inputs.name: note
inputs.about: Store owner's notes about the customer.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.about: A comma-separated string of tags to associate with the customer.

inputs.name: email
inputs.about: The customer's unique email address. Must be unique across all customers.

inputs.name: phone
inputs.about: The customer's phone number in E.164 format. Must be unique across all customers.

inputs.name: addresses
inputs.about: A list of addresses for the customer (up to 10).

inputs.name: last_name
inputs.about: The customer's last name.

inputs.name: first_name
inputs.about: The customer's first name.

inputs.name: tax_exempt
inputs.about: Whether the customer is exempt from taxes.

inputs.name: customer_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the customer to update.

inputs.name: tax_exemptions
inputs.about: Array of applicable tax exemptions.

inputs.name: verified_email
inputs.about: Whether the customer has verified their email address.

inputs.name: send_email_invite
inputs.about: Whether to send an account invitation email to the customer.

inputs.name: send_email_welcome
inputs.about: Whether to send a welcome email to the customer.

inputs.name: multipass_identifier
inputs.about: Multipass identifier for the customer.

inputs.name: sms_marketing_consent
inputs.about: SMS marketing consent information.

inputs.name: email_marketing_consent
inputs.about: Email marketing consent information.

tools.name: Update Customer Address
tools.description: Updates an existing address for a Shopify customer. This action allows you to modify address details such as street address, city, province, country, postal code, and contact information. At least one address field must be provided to update. Requires Protected Customer Data access approval and write_customers scope. Common use cases: - Correct shipping address errors for customers - Update customer contact information - Change billing addresses for customer accounts

inputs.name: zip
inputs.about: Postal code or ZIP code.

inputs.name: city
inputs.about: City, town, or village name.

inputs.name: phone
inputs.about: Contact phone number.

inputs.name: company
inputs.about: Business or company name.

inputs.name: country
inputs.about: Country name.

inputs.name: address1
inputs.about: Primary street address line.

inputs.name: address2
inputs.about: Secondary address field (apartment, suite, etc.).

inputs.name: province
inputs.about: Province or state name.

inputs.name: last_name
inputs.about: Customer's last name.

inputs.name: address_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the address to update.

inputs.name: first_name
inputs.about: Customer's first name.

inputs.name: customer_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the customer whose address is to be updated.

tools.name: Bulk delete customer addresses
tools.description: Performs bulk operations on multiple customer addresses. Currently supports the 'destroy' operation to delete multiple addresses at once. Use this when you need to remove several addresses for a customer in a single API call instead of deleting them one by one.

inputs.name: operation
inputs.about: The bulk operation to execute on the specified addresses. Currently only 'destroy' is supported, which removes multiple addresses at once.

inputs.name: address_ids
inputs.about: Array of address IDs to operate on. Multiple address IDs can be provided to perform bulk operations. At least one address ID must be provided.

inputs.name: customer_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the customer in Shopify.

tools.name: Update dispute evidence
tools.description: Update Shopify Payments dispute evidence using the legacy REST Admin API. The submit_evidence parameter has no effect: the API cannot submit evidence. Merchants must confirm submission in Shopify admin before the due date; submission sends evidence directly to the bank and is final. Requires Shopify-approved access to write_shopify_payments_dispute_evidences.

inputs.name: dispute_id
inputs.about: Numeric Shopify Payments dispute ID.

inputs.name: dispute_evidence
inputs.about: Evidence to update; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Modify an existing draft order
tools.description: Update an existing draft order in Shopify. Use when you need to modify draft order details like customer information, line items, addresses, discounts, notes, or status before completion.

inputs.name: b2b
inputs.about: B2B order designation.

inputs.name: note
inputs.about: Optional merchant note attached to the draft order.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.about: Comma-separated order tags.

inputs.name: email
inputs.about: Customer email address.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: Status - 'open', 'invoice_sent', or 'completed'.

inputs.name: customer
inputs.about: Customer resource object.

inputs.name: line_items
inputs.about: Array of line item objects. Each item can contain product variant or custom line items with details.

inputs.name: tax_exempt
inputs.about: Customer tax exemption status.

inputs.name: customer_id
inputs.about: Customer identifier to associate with the draft order.

inputs.name: shipping_line
inputs.about: Shipping line for draft order.

inputs.name: draft_order_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the draft order to modify.

inputs.name: taxes_included
inputs.about: Whether taxes are included in prices.

inputs.name: billing_address
inputs.about: Billing address for draft order.

inputs.name: note_attributes
inputs.about: Custom metadata objects containing name and value pairs.

inputs.name: applied_discount
inputs.about: Discount applied to draft order or line item.

inputs.name: shipping_address
inputs.about: Shipping address for draft order.

inputs.name: use_customer_default_address
inputs.about: Load customer's default shipping information (default: false).

inputs.name: allow_discount_codes_in_checkout
inputs.about: Enable discount codes at checkout.

tools.name: Update EventBridge webhook subscription
tools.description: Update an Amazon EventBridge webhook subscription in Shopify. Use when you need to modify the ARN or data format of an existing EventBridge webhook. Note: This mutation is deprecated; consider using webhookSubscriptionUpdate for new implementations. For app-specific webhooks, using shopify.app.toml configurations may be easier as they are automatically maintained by Shopify.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID of the webhook subscription to update in GID format (e.g., gid://shopify/WebhookSubscription/1601501331650)

inputs.name: webhookSubscription
inputs.about: Input object containing the EventBridge webhook subscription configuration to update (ARN and/or format)

tools.name: Update Fulfillment Service
tools.description: Update an existing fulfillment service's name, callback URL or capabilities. Only supplied fields are sent. Uses the legacy REST Admin API; the fulfillment_orders_opt_in and requires_shipping_method properties are deprecated.

inputs.name: fulfillment_service
inputs.about: Fields to update. Omitted fields remain unchanged; explicit false and null values are forwarded.

inputs.name: fulfillment_service_id
inputs.about: ID of the fulfillment service to update.

tools.name: Update Fulfillment Tracking
tools.description: Updates tracking information (carrier company, tracking number, or custom URL) for an existing fulfillment. Use this action when: - You need to add or update tracking details for a shipment after the fulfillment was created - The carrier information was not provided during fulfillment creation - Tracking numbers become available after shipment - You want to notify customers about updated tracking information Prerequisites: Requires a valid fulfillment_id from a previously created fulfillment.

inputs.name: fulfillment
inputs.about: The fulfillment object containing tracking information and notification preferences.

inputs.name: fulfillment_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the fulfillment to update. This ID is returned when creating a fulfillment or can be retrieved from order fulfillment lists.

tools.name: Update an Existing Gift Card
tools.description: Updates an existing gift card in Shopify. Use when you need to modify a gift card's expiration date, merchant note, template suffix, or assign it to a customer. Only four properties can be updated after creation: expires_on (expiration date), note (merchant-only note), template_suffix (Liquid template suffix), and customer_id (can only be set if currently null). Note: Gift card balance and initial value cannot be modified through this endpoint.

inputs.name: note
inputs.about: Internal merchant note about the gift card (not visible to customers). Leave empty to keep the current note unchanged.

inputs.name: expires_on
inputs.about: Expiration date for the gift card in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty to keep the current expiration date unchanged. Set to null to remove expiration.

inputs.name: customer_id
inputs.about: ID of the customer to associate with this gift card. IMPORTANT: Can only be set if the gift card is not currently assigned to a customer (i.e., customer_id is currently null). Leave empty to keep the current customer assignment unchanged.

inputs.name: gift_card_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the gift card to update. This is a required parameter.

inputs.name: template_suffix
inputs.about: Suffix for the Liquid template used to render the gift card online (e.g., 'birthday' renders gift_card.birthday.liquid). Leave empty to keep the current template suffix unchanged.

tools.name: Update inventory item
tools.description: Updates properties of an inventory item in Shopify. An inventory item represents the physical good behind a product variant, containing metadata like SKU, cost, origin, and shipping requirements. Use this action to modify these properties - NOT to adjust inventory quantities (use inventory level actions for quantity changes). Common use cases: updating product costs, changing SKUs, setting country of origin for customs, or toggling inventory tracking.

inputs.name: inventory_item
inputs.about: The inventory item object containing properties to update. Only include fields you want to change - all fields are optional.

inputs.name: inventory_item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the inventory item to update. You can get this from a product variant's inventory_item_id field.

tools.name: Update Marketing Event
tools.description: Update an existing Shopify marketing event, including its budget, timing, and remote identifier. Budget updates require currency and budget type.

inputs.name: paid
inputs.about: Whether the event is paid or organic (deprecated). READ-ONLY after creation - cannot be updated.

inputs.name: budget
inputs.about: Campaign budget amount. If specified, currency and budget_type are required. UPDATABLE.

inputs.name: currency
inputs.about: Budget currency code (ISO 4217). Required if budget is specified. UPDATABLE.

inputs.name: ended_at
inputs.about: Actual campaign completion timestamp in ISO 8601 format. UPDATABLE.

inputs.name: remote_id
inputs.about: Remote identifier for validation of engagement data. UPDATABLE.

inputs.name: event_type
inputs.about: Marketing event classification. Valid values: ad, post, message, retargeting, transactional, affiliate, loyalty, newsletter, abandoned_cart. READ-ONLY after creation - cannot be updated.

inputs.name: manage_url
inputs.about: Link to campaign management interface. READ-ONLY after creation - cannot be updated.

inputs.name: started_at
inputs.about: Campaign commencement timestamp in ISO 8601 format. UPDATABLE.

inputs.name: utm_medium
inputs.about: Traffic channel specification. READ-ONLY after creation - cannot be updated.

inputs.name: utm_source
inputs.about: Traffic origin identifier. READ-ONLY after creation - cannot be updated.

inputs.name: budget_type
inputs.about: Budget model: daily or lifetime. Required if budget is specified. UPDATABLE.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Campaign narrative details. READ-ONLY after creation - cannot be updated.

inputs.name: preview_url
inputs.about: Campaign preview destination. READ-ONLY after creation - cannot be updated.

inputs.name: utm_campaign
inputs.about: Campaign identifier for traffic attribution. READ-ONLY after creation - cannot be updated.

inputs.name: referring_domain
inputs.about: Destination domain (deprecated). Required if marketing_channel is search or social at creation. READ-ONLY after creation - cannot be updated.

inputs.name: marketing_channel
inputs.about: Distribution channel. Valid values: search, display, social, email, referral. READ-ONLY after creation - cannot be updated.

inputs.name: marketing_event_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the marketing event to update.

inputs.name: scheduled_to_end_at
inputs.about: Planned campaign conclusion timestamp in ISO 8601 format. UPDATABLE.

tools.name: Update blog metafield (Deprecated)
tools.description: Update an existing metafield for a blog. Use when you need to modify metafield properties like value, type, or description for a blog resource.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: The new value type of the metafield. If not provided, the existing type will be kept.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new value for the metafield. If not provided, the existing value will be kept.

inputs.name: blog_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the blog that owns the metafield.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: A new description of the information that the metafield contains. If not provided, the existing description will be kept.

inputs.name: metafield_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the metafield to update.

tools.name: Update metafield by ID
tools.description: Update an existing Shopify metafield by its ID. Use when you need to modify metafield properties like value, type, or description.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: The new value type of the metafield. If not provided, the existing type will be kept.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new value for the metafield. If not provided, the existing value will be kept.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: A new description of the information that the metafield contains. If not provided, the existing description will be kept.

inputs.name: metafield_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the metafield to update.

tools.name: Update metafield definition
tools.description: Update a Shopify metafield definition's configuration including name, description, validation rules, access settings, and capabilities. Use when you need to modify an existing metafield definition to change display text, add/remove validations, adjust API access permissions, or enable/disable capabilities like admin filtering or unique value constraints.
